item.tib: kun gsal byams ma chen mo'i bkra shis yon tan gyi mchod 'bul rgyas par spro ba gter gyi tshom bu
item.coloph: de ltar kun gsal byams ma yi/ chog khrigs yid bzhin nor bu de'i/ bkra shis yon tan mchod 'bul skabs/ cung tsam rgyas par spro ba ni/ dkyil chog gzhan dang rigs 'gres dang*/ blo chung rang 'dra'i 'dod tshim slad/ lha tshogs gtso 'khor thams cad kyis(kyi/)don dang yon tan yin tshul rnams/ rgyud 'bum gzungs dang kun gsal gyis(gyi/)dgongs don ma lus mdor bsdus nas/ mdo smad skyes pa'i ser gzugs pa/ drung mu nyi wer phral bris 'di/ 'gal gyur rgyal yum gtso 'khor dang / rtsa rgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ gal te legs tshogs mchis srid na/ lam du zhugs pa'i dga' ston shog bkra shis/ zhal dro//
